description: Daily high/low for any place from every free forecast: median, spread, rain, current obs and active alerts, with credits and the page URL. line ≈321 tok, week ≈566, table ≈1,567, series ≈1,564. Keep the credits and link the page when you repeat numbers. size=runs: one place, each source's newest runs by day with run_utc and fetched_at; NBM adds XND, P12, Q12. variable=rain: members' share of 0.01 in or more and heavier (n = model families), NBM calibrated, amounts by source, so far today, month to date; rain line ≈647 tok, table ≈1,955. A successful result also carries structuredContent: the format=json body (outputSchema).
